overlay.render_settings.title: Render Settings
overlay.render_settings.description: Configure output quality and green screen (greenwall) settings used by the renderer.
overlay.render_settings.output.format.he: Output file format for the final rendered image.
overlay.render_settings.output.jpeg_qual: 1–100. Higher = better quality, larger file. Recommended for print: 92–95.
overlay.render_settings.output.jpeg_subs: Color subsampling. 0 keeps best color edges; 2 reduces file size but may blur colored edges.
overlay.render_settings.output.jpeg_opti: Better compression (smaller file), slightly slower saving.
overlay.render_settings.output.jpeg_prog: Progressive loading in browsers. Usually not important for printing.
overlay.render_settings.output.dpi.label: DPI metadata
overlay.render_settings.output.dpi.help: Metadata only (pixels do not change). Useful for print workflows (e.g. 300 DPI).
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.switch: Auto uses the template flag (e.g. greenwall="1"). On/Off overrides it globally.
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.mode.o: Auto (diff if reference exists, else chroma)
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.mode.h: Select how the mask is created: diff (with reference) or chroma key (green dominance).
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.diff_t: Diff sensitivity. Lower = keep more person; higher = stricter background removal.
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.green_: Minimum green channel value required before a pixel can be considered “green”.
How strongly green must dominate red/blue. Higher = stricter (less false keying, but may create holes).
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.blur_r: Smooth the mask for cleaner edges (typical: 1–3).
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.spill_: Reduce green color spill on edges (0–1).
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.close_: Close small holes in the mask (morphological closing). Typical: 0–2.
overlay.camera_settings.liveview_always_: Keep LiveView running all the time
If disabled, LiveView starts only when needed. Before the first capture a 3-second warmup countdown is shown.

If enabled, LiveView runs continuously (increased heat and power usage; may reduce stability during long events). Recommended: lower FPS when idle and use higher FPS only during active photo sessions.
overlay.render_settings.greenwall.write_: If enabled, the renderer exports the mask image for debugging/tuning.

overlay.camerabridge_settings.title: CameraBridge Settings
overlay.camerabridge_settings.descriptio: Configure API server and worker settings for the CameraBridge service.
Absolute path to the API server executable (required).
overlay.settings.camera_server.oneinstan: Enable only one CameraBridge-API-SERVER at the same time (*recommend)
overlay.camerabridge_settings.bind_addre: IP to listen on. Use 127.0.0.1 for local-only access, or 0.0.0.0 / + for LAN access (firewall required).
Defines on which network interface the HTTP server listens:
Important: For LAN binding, Windows Firewall must allow the port (e.g. 8052).
Local API port for the API server (default: 8052).
overlay.camerabridge_settings.mjpeg_path: HTTP path for the MJPEG stream used by the preview element.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.api_key.hi: Required for /api/* endpoints (sent as X-Api-Key). MJPEG stream remains unprotected. Leave empty to disable authentication.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.health.int: How often the watchdog/health check runs.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.health.tim: How long to wait before a health check is considered failed.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.logging.lo: Relative or absolute path to the API server log file.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.worker.arg: Optional command line args passed to the worker.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.worker.not: These options control how the API server supervises and restarts the worker process.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.liveview_f: Frames per second for MJPEG live view. Lower values reduce CPU/USB load.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.keepalive_: How long the worker stays active without requests before releasing resources.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.load_wia_d: Enable only if you need WIA device discovery. Leaving it off can speed up startup and reduce conflicts.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.capture_fo: Folder where captured originals are stored by default (must be writable).
overlay.camerabridge_settings.note: Note: Some changes may require restarting the CameraBridge service to take effect.
overlay.camerabridge_settings.worker.arg: Wrong arguments can prevent the CameraBridge worker from starting. Unknown args are ignored.
